stemMd: A square grid has 4 rows and 5 columns of cells. How many cells touch the outside boundary?
explanationMd: There are twenty cells total. The interior consists of (4−2)×(5−2)=2×3=6 cells. Subtracting leaves fourteen boundary cells. This avoids double-counting corners.

distractorRationale.e: This counts interior cells as well.
distractorRationale.d: This counts corners twice when adding edge rows and columns.
distractorRationale.a: This is the number of interior cells.
